atoms.b: Alongside mammals, birds, fish, insects and reptiles, there are also ((++amphibians dragons)).
They have ((++wet dry)), bare skin and can change their body temperature. They usually live on land but not far from water.

instruction.text: Is this animal an amphibian or not?
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Metamorphosis means transformation. Some amphibians go through metamorphosis, and they change their form.
atoms.sound: Metamorphosis means transformation. Some amphibians go through metamorphosis, and they change their form.

text: Some insects also go through metamorphosis, for example, when a caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.text: A simple example is the frog: a female frog lays eggs, otherwise known as frogspawn. The male frog then fertilises these eggs.
atoms.sound: A simple example is the frog: a female frog lays eggs, otherwise known as frogspawn. The male frog then fertilizes these eggs.

atoms.text: Tadpoles evolve from the fertilised frogspawn. They have gills and use their tails to swim through water.
atoms.sound: Tadpoles evolve from the fertilised frogspawn. They have gills and use their tails to swim through water.

atoms.text: Tadpoles turn into frogs over the course of a few weeks. First, they grow back legs, then they absorb their tail and grow front legs. The young frog then grows for 2-4 years until they become an adult.
